quotes.text: Headless simply means the selling engine lives apart from the screen a person looks at. The engine doesn't care if a customer uses a website, a phone app, a self-service kiosk, or a store worker's tablet.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A plain-language definition of headless commerce.

quotes.text: Customers don't care which technical system answered their question. They care that the price on their phone matches the price in the store, and that an item shown as available can actually be ordered.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Frames omnichannel consistency from the customer's point of view.

quotes.text: So a physical store becomes more than shelves and a register. It becomes a connected part of the whole operation where staff can help customers buy, collect, return, or order products using the information the business already manages.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains how the store's role changes with connected commerce.

quotes.text: Recommendations don't read a customer's mind. They use shopping and purchase information to suggest items a customer might want to see.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Demystifies product recommendations without overselling them.

quotes.text: If your business has messy product details or unclear rules, commerce just connects that mess faster.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A candid warning that software does not fix poor data or processes.

takeaways: Dynamics 365 Commerce connects websites, stores, call centers and back office around one shared view of products, prices, stock, orders and customers.
The Commerce Scale Unit is the headless engine behind every channel, so a new app or storefront reuses the same pricing, stock and order rules through APIs.
Commerce connects people and processes but does not replace them: clean product data, clear business rules and staff who pick, pack and serve remain essential.
hook: A customer buys online, picks up in one store and returns in another, and suddenly four disconnected systems have to agree. This knowledge nugget explains Dynamics 365 Commerce in plain English for retail, IT and business leaders, covering the customer journey, Store Commerce, the headless Commerce Scale Unit and the data behind it, and what the platform still leaves to people.
